content: The test image shows an opened soybean pod with 3 seeds. The rightmost seed has a prominent **purple/violet discoloration centered around the hilum**. Two seeds appear normal yellow. White Mold shows white cottony growth on stems/pods exteriors — not matching the purple hilum stain seen in the test image.

**Conclusion:** The test image shows a soybean pod opened to reveal seeds — one seed has a distinct **purple/violet spot centered at the hilum**, with normal yellow seeds alongside. This is the hallmark symptom of Purple_Seed_Stain (caused by *Cercospora kikuchii*), as confirmed by the nearly identical reference image panel. The small amount of white material between seeds is within normal range and not diagnostic of White Mold or Downy Mildew.
